query: How many days do I have to request a refund?

corpus.content: Our standard refund policy permits customers to request a full refund within 30 days of the initial subscription purchase date. Refund requests submitted after 30 days are non-refundable.
API rate limits are capped at 1,000 requests per minute per organization token. Exceeding this limit returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
Enterprise accounts receive a 99.99% monthly uptime SLA guarantee with 1-hour priority support response times for Sev 1 incidents.
